extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.26[CR]- Replace the genre dropdown with a full illustrated five-column grid on Movies/TV focus; show content only after a genre or All selection.[CR]- Move In Progress after TV. Group sports and add-on subscriptions under Extras, with access labels that distinguish confirmed Prime inclusion.[CR]- Recognize Amazon's genre See more links despite decorative Link Arrow text.[CR]- Follow the actual page-owned Grid PaginateCollection protocol with unchanged provider tokens and capability fields.[CR]- Preserve first-two-page warming, early lookahead and current card selection on append.[CR]- Report collection request fields, parser structure, returned counts, next state and explicit provider-declared end without exposing tokens or account identifiers.[CR]- Preserve original glow textures, title hierarchy, description cleanup, fresh in-place In Progress and all native authentication/playback code.
